Club trace.th: เส้นทางไม้กอล์ฟ

Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.en: Tap the club head at address. Tracking stops at the top or at the first loss of confidence.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.ko: 어드레스의 클럽 헤드를 탭하세요. 추적은 탑 또는 처음 신뢰도가 낮아지는 지점에서 중단됩니다.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.ja: アドレス時のクラブヘッドをタップします。追跡はトップまたは最初に信頼度が下がった時点で停止します。
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.zh-Hans: 点按站位时的杆头。追踪在顶点或首次置信度下降时停止。
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.zh-Hant: 點一下站位時的桿頭。追蹤在頂點或首次信賴度下降時停止。
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.es: Toca la cabeza del palo en la colocación. El seguimiento termina arriba o al perder confianza.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.pt-BR: Toque na cabeça do taco na posição inicial. O rastreamento para no topo ou na primeira perda de confiança.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.de: Schlägerkopf in der Ansprechposition antippen. Die Verfolgung endet am höchsten Punkt oder beim ersten Vertrauensverlust.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.fr: Touchez la tête du club à l’adresse. Le suivi s’arrête au sommet ou dès la première perte de confiance.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.it: Tocca la testa del bastone all’address. Il tracciamento termina al vertice o alla prima perdita di affidabilità.
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.th: แตะหัวไม้ตอนจรดลูก การติดตามหยุดที่จุดสูงสุดหรือเมื่อความมั่นใจลดลงครั้งแรก
Tap the club head at address. Tracking s.vi: Chạm đầu gậy ở tư thế chuẩn bị. Theo dõi dừng ở đỉnh hoặc khi độ tin cậy giảm lần đầu.

Set Address and Top markers before track.en: Set Address and Top markers before tracking.
Set Address and Top markers before track.ko: 추적하기 전에 어드레스와 탑 마커를 설정하세요.
Set Address and Top markers before track.ja: 追跡前にアドレスとトップのマーカーを設定してください。
Set Address and Top markers before track.zh-Hans: 追踪前请设置站位和顶点标记。
Set Address and Top markers before track.zh-Hant: 追蹤前請設定站位和頂點標記。
Set Address and Top markers before track.es: Establece los marcadores de colocación y tope antes del seguimiento.
Set Address and Top markers before track.pt-BR: Defina os marcadores de posição inicial e topo antes de rastrear.
Set Address and Top markers before track.de: Vor der Verfolgung Ansprech- und Top-Marker setzen.
Set Address and Top markers before track.fr: Définissez les repères d’adresse et de sommet avant le suivi.
Set Address and Top markers before track.it: Imposta i marcatori di address e vertice prima del tracciamento.
Set Address and Top markers before track.th: ตั้งจุดเริ่มและจุดสูงสุดก่อนติดตาม
Set Address and Top markers before track.vi: Đặt mốc chuẩn bị và đỉnh trước khi theo dõi.

Track backswing.ja: バックスイングを追跡
Track backswing.th: ติดตามแบ็กสวิง

Tracking lost.th: ติดตามไม่สำเร็จ

Tracking ended at the top marker..en: Tracking ended at the top marker.
Tracking ended at the top marker..ja: トップのマーカーで追跡を終了しました。
Tracking ended at the top marker..zh-Hans: 追踪已在顶点标记结束。
Tracking ended at the top marker..zh-Hant: 追蹤已在頂點標記結束。
Tracking ended at the top marker..es: El seguimiento terminó en el marcador superior.
Tracking ended at the top marker..pt-BR: O rastreamento terminou no marcador do topo.
Tracking ended at the top marker..fr: Le suivi s’est terminé au repère du sommet.
Tracking ended at the top marker..it: Il tracciamento è terminato al marcatore del vertice.
Tracking ended at the top marker..th: การติดตามสิ้นสุดที่จุดสูงสุด
Tracking ended at the top marker..vi: Theo dõi kết thúc tại mốc đỉnh.

The trace is image-space motion of the s.en: The trace is image-space motion of the selected region. It does not measure club speed, ball launch or impact. Nothing is drawn after tracking loss.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.ko: 궤적은 선택한 영역의 영상 내 움직임입니다. 클럽 속도, 볼 발사 또는 임팩트를 측정하지 않습니다. 추적 중단 후에는 표시하지 않습니다.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.ja: 軌跡は選択した領域の画像内の動きです。クラブ速度、ボールの打ち出し、インパクトは測定しません。追跡喪失後は描画しません。
The trace is image-space motion of the s.zh-Hans: 轨迹是所选区域在图像中的运动，不测量杆头速度、球的发射或击球。丢失追踪后不再绘制。
The trace is image-space motion of the s.zh-Hant: 軌跡是所選區域在影像中的運動，不測量桿頭速度、球的發射或擊球。遺失追蹤後不再繪製。
The trace is image-space motion of the s.es: La traza muestra el movimiento de la región en la imagen. No mide velocidad del palo, lanzamiento ni impacto. No se dibuja nada tras perder el seguimiento.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.pt-BR: O traçado mostra o movimento da região na imagem. Não mede velocidade do taco, lançamento ou impacto. Nada é desenhado após perder o rastreamento.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.de: Die Spur zeigt die Bewegung des gewählten Bildbereichs. Sie misst weder Schlägergeschwindigkeit noch Ballstart oder Treffmoment. Nach Verlust wird nichts gezeichnet.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.fr: La trace montre le mouvement de la région dans l’image. Elle ne mesure ni vitesse du club, ni lancement, ni impact. Rien n’est tracé après la perte du suivi.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.it: La traccia mostra il movimento della regione nell’immagine. Non misura velocità del bastone, lancio o impatto. Dopo la perdita del tracciamento non viene disegnato nulla.
The trace is image-space motion of the s.th: เส้นทางแสดงการเคลื่อนที่ของพื้นที่ที่เลือกในภาพ ไม่ได้วัดความเร็วไม้ การปล่อยลูก หรืออิมแพกต์ และไม่วาดต่อหลังติดตามหาย
The trace is image-space motion of the s.vi: Đường vẽ thể hiện chuyển động vùng đã chọn trong ảnh. Không đo tốc độ gậy, phóng bóng hay va chạm. Không vẽ tiếp sau khi mất dấu.
